speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. Your wife mentioned you've been acting bizarrely and agitated; can you please tell me exactly what you experienced in the moments leading up to this visit, and have you consumed anything unusual or taken any medications recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia (Active phase with persecutory delusions and disorganized behavior).

Based on the 6-week history of bizarre agitation, beliefs of being controlled by the NSA, social withdrawal, and functional decline leading to job loss, the clinical picture strongly supports a diagnosis of schizophrenia. I will proceed with treatment planning and risk assessment.
